manifest.summary: Run the locally installed upstream application with independent configurations, tasks and logs.

diagnostics.mxu_finish_action: The action after MXU finishes may affect subsequent queue work.
diagnostics.mxu_autostart_invalid: The automatic-run instance is missing or has a duplicate ID. Use Edit configuration to select a valid instance, close the editor, then reload the plan.
diagnostics.mxu_autostart_missing: No automatic-run instance is selected. Use Edit configuration to select it for this bound user, close the editor, then reload the plan. The active tab is not an automatic-run target.
diagnostics.mfa_launch_owner: In Script Settings → Startup Settings, set the game launcher path and select Start software and script. If the project starts the game, select Start script only. Custom Program tasks cannot launch the game before window connection.
diagnostics.mfa_finish_action: Review the after-task action in MFA startup settings. Shutdown, restart or closing a required target can interrupt restoration or subsequent work.
diagnostics.maas_unknown_task_preserved: Unknown tasks and their settings are preserved.
diagnostics.maas_computer_operation_requires_host_po: Disable the native power task and let the queue handle completion actions.
diagnostics.maas_finish_action_requires_host_policy: Set the script completion action to None or a supported close action. Let the queue handle completion actions.
diagnostics.maas_local_task_items_required: The current instance has no saved local task list. Save its configuration first.
diagnostics.maas_missing_profile_default_used: The profile name differs from the global configuration being read. Check the native settings.
diagnostics.maas_new_defaults_require_native_materia: Default tasks are not fully saved in the current instance. Review and save its task list first.
diagnostics.maas_unknown_import_preserved: Unknown interface imports and their settings are preserved.
diagnostics.maas_declared_import_unavailable: Some declared interface files were not found. Check the script directory.
